note: Ports a widget accepts under some parameter setting, which TYPES.inputs -- the definition the palette, the Inspector and every reader meets first -- does not list. Found 2026-10-14 by checking every edge in the six shipped examples against the declared ports: each of these runs, so the declaration is simply not where the behaviour is. Recorded as a ceiling rather than fixed in one go, because widening TYPES.inputs changes what the palette offers and what a connection check admits, and that is a change per widget rather than a sweep.
ceilingRule: May be lowered freely and never raised. Declaring a port removes it from this list; a new widget that hides a port raises the count and fails the build.
